title: Ready Together: 53rd Wing at Black Flag and Gray Flag 2026
description: U.S. Air Force Airmen assigned to the 53rd Wing participate in Black Flag and Gray Flag at Naval Base Ventura County Point Mugu, California, Sept. 10–25, 2026. The large-force test events bring joint and allied partners together to evaluate the integration and interoperability of combat capabilities in an operationally relevant environment. Through interviews with test leaders and footage of flight-line operations, “Ready Together” explores how operational testing helps teams understand what works, identify integration challenges and inform improvements that support warfighter readiness. (U.S. Air Force video by Staff Sgt. Christian Conrad)
keywords: black flag, operational test, joint interoperability, 53rd wing, Gray Flag, NAVBASE Ventura City Point Mugu

transcript.text: Success for an event doesn't mean the
blue forces went and just annihilated
all the red and high fives all around .
At Black and Gray Flag , the
fifty-third wing tests alongside joint
and allied partners , not just to see
what works but what works together .
When we develop things individually for
platforms , we all high five on our
individual platform at the end of the
day and say , hey , cool , our F-18
thing worked or F-15 thing worked .
These exercises actually enable . The
joint force to play together and win in
combat . What works on our systems ?
What doesn't work on these other
systems ? What can they learn together ?
Because ultimately the warfighter just
wants something that works . They don't
care what specific system works , and a
useful test does not have to be a
flawless one . An equally successful
event might be , hey , we recognize
this very fixable thing for this
platform or between these platforms .
So at the end of the exercise we've
achieved knowledge of either things
working as intended or we didn't
succeed here but we know why and can
fix the problem and then deliver the
next version of software that enables
success . For the fifty-third wing ,
that means finding the gaps , informing
the fixes , and helping deliver
capabilities the warfighter can trust .
We are doing something that no one else
can do right now , and that should give
any of our adversaries pause .
